authority_boundary.forbidden_output_role: regression guardrail for draft transcription behavior

scope_note: Phrase-level positive gold cases are P1-P4. Some forbidden patterns are generalized from P1-P5 review because they prevent repeated construction errors during later validation.

forbidden_outputs.when_visible_evidence: COMP-020 勾 plus visible embedded/lower/nearby string number such as 三 or 四
forbidden_outputs.required_repair: 合读为 勾三/勾四 and mark context inheritance only if upper slots are blank
forbidden_outputs.reason: 右手动作 + 数字必须先尝试合读。

forbidden_outputs.forbidden_pattern: 裸弦数 or 挑? omitted
forbidden_outputs.when_visible_evidence: COMP-018 挑 plus embedded/lower/nearby string number
forbidden_outputs.required_repair: 合读为 挑六/挑四/挑七 as supported by visible construction
forbidden_outputs.reason: 挑的乙形下承结构不得漏读。

forbidden_outputs.required_repair: 读作 少息 and keep non-sounding timing marker
render as 承前 behavior unless user asks to surface 就
forbidden_outputs.reason: 就是承前 marker，不是 timing marker。

forbidden_outputs.forbidden_pattern: 大指/徽位 from connected COMP-027 shape
forbidden_outputs.when_visible_evidence: COMP-027 散音起始 connected grass-head-like component
forbidden_outputs.required_repair: 读作 散音起始/open-string state layer; require visible right-hand/string for sounding candidate

forbidden_outputs.when_visible_evidence: COMP-018 挑 visible in right-hand slot
forbidden_outputs.reason: 不能从邻近模板复制抹。

forbidden_outputs.when_visible_evidence: visible 大指注下七徽，挑七弦 before 急进复
forbidden_outputs.required_repair: 撞；大指注下七徽，挑七弦；急进复
forbidden_outputs.reason: 急进复前的发声构字不得漏掉。

forbidden_outputs.when_visible_evidence: 名指 + 七九徽 + COMP-018 挑 + 六
COMP-027 散音起始 plus COMP-018 挑 plus 五

forbidden_outputs.forbidden_pattern: 轮/撞 swapped via raw fallback
forbidden_outputs.when_visible_evidence: COMP-028 撞 and COMP-029 轮 after v0.4 correction

forbidden_outputs.forbidden_pattern: 泛起/泛止/少息/句号/就 as independent sounding_unit
forbidden_outputs.reason: 非发声 marker 默认不生成 sounding_unit。

forbidden_outputs.forbidden_pattern: using jianpu/old OCR/old CSV/page layout as score fact authority
forbidden_outputs.required_repair: mark unknown_from_crop or NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW; do not infer event count/rhythm/pitch/string/hui/action

forbidden_outputs.forbidden_pattern: 掐起 as independent sounding unit with no left-hand/hui attachment
forbidden_outputs.when_visible_evidence: COMP-022 掐起 near 名指/position evidence
forbidden_outputs.required_repair: attach as special-technique candidate and mark sounding policy needs_review
forbidden_outputs.reason: 掐起需与名指/跪指等按位绑定，发声策略需审阅。
